title: Substack paid newsletter
one_liner: Readers pay a monthly subscription for your writing.
pay: You set the price; Substack takes 10% of paid subscriptions plus Stripe (about 2.9% + 30c).
steps: Turn on paid with one clear extra.
catch: Only a small share of free readers usually pay; you need a list first.

match.first_step: Publish one free post this week on a topic your viewers ask about.
